publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for private Organization export request, status, PIN, download, retry, cancel, delete, and generation behavior.
Domain service contract for Organization export lifecycle and generated ZIP delivery.
Job type factory for worker-driven private Organization export generation and generated-bundle cleanup.
Code-declared recurring scheduler definitions for Organization export cleanup and timeout sweeps.

dependsOn.description: Export generation reads approved logo bytes through the public asset service seam.
Export generation reads current logo relationship metadata through the branding service seam.
Export request and generation validate source Organization authority through Organization Core.
Export generation reads business-unit projection data through the business units service.
Export generation reads business-unit membership projection data through the memberships service.
Export generation reads legal profile projection data through the legal details service.
Export generation reads location projection data through the locations service.
Export generation reads weekly slot and exception projection data through the opening hours service.
Export generation reads reference value projection data through the reference catalogues service.
Export requests enqueue background generation jobs, classify stale running work, and declare cleanup/timeout recurring schedules through the platform job-processing seams.
Export generation may send ready and failed notification emails through the notification delivery seam.
Tenant-admin export routes require an active tenant session context.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing requester-only access, PIN handling, ZIP encryption, private download headers, expiry/delete behavior, or manifest contents can break security and export consumers.
